order: Write up the tenth in this long-running series of delta reviews, the order paired with the account of what its executor found, covering the round-5e fixes. The review is anchored to the two pinned commits marking where round-5d ends and round-5e begins, cited as that specific pair rather than folded into a shared range. Both files are wholly new additions placed under roster/ itself. The tree elsewhere stays untouched, and nothing on file is rewritten. Hold the scope to exactly that pinned pair, not the string of rounds behind it, since this pass answers only for what those two commits changed. State, as a standalone sentence, that only a clean verdict against that pair moves the two pending work orders out of revise; a partial or qualified result changes nothing about where they stand today.
claims: The order and the account of what its executor found went in under roster/ as two brand-new files, 118 lines together and no deletions anywhere in the tree. The two pinned commits are cited as that specific pair rather than folded into a shared range. Only a clean verdict against exactly that pair moves the two pending work orders out of revise; the write-up treats that fact as the pass's single deliverable outcome, with nothing further claimed beyond it.
